name: 33126 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33126 (Miami) has 97 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33126 (Miami) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33126 (Miami) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
